rca of the issue: Original bug: axios baseURL was set from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at build time, making all API calls absolute cross-origin to a specific preview host. When the platform rotated the preview URL, the browser served the app from a new hostname but axios kept calling the old host — this produced 'Network Error' due to CORS/cookies mismatch. Fix: use relative '/api' baseURL so requests are always same-origin and Kubernetes ingress routes /api/* to backend:8001. Verified: 0 cross-origin requests observed; login and all regressions pass.
